Calculate and display the differences between two .csnap files, or between one
.csnap file and the current live system state.

This tool helps visualize administrative velocity and object mutation across
time boundaries.

  Diff two csnap files
  zqk.test system state-diff before.csnap after.csnap
  Diff a csnap against current live system state
  zqk.test system state-diff .zqk-state/system-state.csnap

Usage:
  zqk.test system state-diff <snapshot-a> [snapshot-b] [flags]

Flags:
      --brief                   Only show counts, do not show detailed field changes
      --columns string          Override column widths for table output (format: field:width)
  -f, --format string           Output format (table, json, jsonl, yaml, csv, json-rpc, stream, agent-prompt, semantic-link) (default "table")
      --ignore-scheduler-down   Ignore scheduler down warning/lockdown
  -o, --output string           Write output to file
  -q, --quiet                   Suppress non-essential output
      --timeout duration        Timeout for command execution (0 = auto-calculate)
  -v, --verbose                 Verbose output

Global Flags:
      --allow-degraded   Allow scheduler-dependent commands to run when scheduler daemon is not running
